msg: Hi. We want to complete our PADI open water: we have referrals and e-learning certificates. We would also like a refresher first. How does the 2 day open water referral course cost plus a mini course the day before. 2 persons. Thanks
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

That sounds like a great plan! Since you’ve completed your referral requirements, you can finish your PADI Open Water certification with the 2-day Referral Course. Just a note: the refresher is for already-certified divers who haven’t dived in over two years; it isn’t required before completing an Open Water Referral Course, and the mini-course doesn’t count toward certification.

The online prices include the 10% website discount. For two people, the booking system will show the exact total.

The refresher is a one-day activity with a pool session and one ocean dive. The Referral Course takes two days and includes four certification dives. You’ll need to stay overnight on the islands between the course days; accommodation isn’t included. The refresher requires at least *12 hours before flying*, and the Referral Course requires *18 hours* after diving.

If you’re already certified and haven’t dived in over two years, the refresher is normally required. If you’re not yet certified, please check with your home PADI center whether a refresher is appropriate before your referral dives.

To complete an Open Water course started at another PADI center, you’ll need the PADI referral form signed by your original instructor; this is the Referral Open Water Course, not a regular dive trip.

To give you the exact price I need to know where you're starting from: would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Plans and prices change depending on the departure point. 🌊

msg: Ok. Thanks. We will work out the best days. Do you recommend any hotels on the island convenient for the diving?
reply:
Absolutely! For the most convenient access to diving, I’d recommend *Hotel San Pedro de Majagua* or *Hotel Cocoliso* on Isla Grande—our dive base is at both, and pick-up is direct.

Other nearby hotels with maritime access include *Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras, and Pao Pao*. Pick-up arrangements depend on the hotel’s boat access, and accommodation is booked directly with the hotel; it isn’t included in the diving plan.

Do you already have a hotel in mind? I can help you check whether it’s on the pick-up list.

Since you’ll be staying on the islands, the refresher is booked as *“Dive Mini Course (already on the islands)”*. The online price is *USD 134 per person*—the $50 figure isn’t the listed price. Book and pay through this link: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/dive-mini-course-already-on-island/20?language=en

For the two-day Open Water Referral Course, use the booking link for the Cartagena departure plan, as there isn’t a separate referral-course link for guests already on the islands. The team can help confirm the right booking setup for your dates.

Since you’ll be staying on the islands, pick-up and return are at your hotel if it has maritime access.

Which hotel or island are you staying at? That way we can arrange pickup.
